author: Kevin Ajili
name: Kevin Ajili's darktable styles
description: Seventeen styles from Kevin Ajili's darktable-styles repository, popularized through his YouTube channel: eight creative looks (atlantic, chromium, lucid, noir, pacific film, pastel, standard and warm film) built around sigmoid, color balance RGB, color equalizer, rgb primaries and diffuse or sharpen, plus nine tool styles covering auto exposure in four strengths, denoise, grain, a 4:5 frame, light simulation and highlight reduction.
